Done. Build passes and I smoke-tested the full flow (add → finish → notes → 404 for bad id).

- `lib/books.js` — reads/writes `data/books.json` (created on first run if missing)
- `app/page.jsx` — home: "Currently reading" + "Finished" lists, "Mark finished" buttons, add-book form
- `app/books/[id]/page.jsx` — detail page with title, author, editable notes; URL is shareable (`/books/<id>`)
- `app/actions.js` — server actions for add/finish/save-notes

Run it with `npm run dev`. No accounts, no DB — books survive restarts in `data/books.json`.
